title: Dark mode
description: Add a dark theme and a way to switch to it, independent of the app's language setting (LODGY-30). Requested directly by wardens using the app at night/in dim common areas. Depends on LODGY-36 landing first - dark mode should adjust the same RAG status-color tokens LODGY-36 defines, not invent its own.
acceptanceCriteria: A dark color scheme exists for LodgyTheme with adequate contrast on all screens
Warden can switch between Light/Dark/System default from the More tab
Switching applies immediately without restarting the app

history.note: Added from the v2 feedback session (warden interviews after the v1 field test) and from buried enhancement/limitation notes surfaced while re-reading the full v1 board history.
Added an explicit dependency on LODGY-36 (RAG color tokens) - sequence that ticket first so this one adjusts the same tokens instead of the two drifting independently.

Starting - LODGY-36's tokens are in, so this is a ThemePreferences DataStore (Light/Dark/System), a ThemeViewModel feeding LodgyTheme in MainActivity, and a picker in More. Reading the preference as a Flow so the switch recomposes in place; no activity recreate, unlike the language switcher which has to go through AppCompatDelegate.

Dark mode landed on top of LODGY-36's tokens. data/prefs/ThemePreferences.kt stores LIGHT/DARK/SYSTEM in its own DataStore (unknown/absent value reads as SYSTEM); ui/theme/ThemeViewModel.kt exposes it as a StateFlow and writes changes back. MainActivity collects it and resolves SYSTEM through isSystemInDarkTheme() before handing darkTheme to LodgyTheme, which already picks DarkStatusColors for the same flag - so dark mode adjusts LODGY-36's RAG tokens rather than defining any of its own. The picker is More -> Appearance; it applies on tap with no confirm and no activity recreate (unlike the language switcher, which has to go through AppCompatDelegate), because both the dialog and MainActivity read the same DataStore flow. Darkened LodgySecondary/LodgyError into DarkColors so the dark scheme is not carrying light-scheme accents. Renamed LanguageOptionRow to OptionRow now that both dialogs use it. ThemeViewModelTest covers stored value, the SYSTEM fallback, and persistence. testDebugUnitTest green.
